Description: Used and required for kpoints_mode=mesh. Grid size along axis 1, 2 and 3 (for Monkhorst-Pack grids). Ex: kpoints_mesh, 4, 4, 4.
Used and required for kpoints_mode=mesh. Ex: kpoints_offset, 0, 0, 0
Used and required for kpoints_mode=explicit. A string or combination of strings with format: x-coordinate y-coordinate z-coordinate weight. Ex: kpoints, '2.0 2.0 2.0 1.0; 2.0 2.0 2.0 1.0'
Used and required for kpoints_mode=path. Density of points along the path. Let AiiDA calculate the standard high-symmetry path. Ex: kpoints_distance, 0.015
Smearing temperature for metallic systems. Requires units. Ex: 25 meV or 300 K.
Real-space grid resolution. Requires units. Ex: 200 Ry.
Maximum number of self-consistent field cycles allowed. Ex: 100.
Fails the calculation if it hits scf-max-iter without converging.
The fraction of the new density matrix mixed with the old one. Ex: 0.25.
Standard sizes for the pseudo-atomic orbital basis set.
The energy shift determining the confinement radius of the orbitals. Requires units. Ex: 0.02 Ry.
The algorithm used for structural relaxation. Use CG for Conjugate Gradients.
The maximum number of optimization steps. Default 0 performs a single-point energy calculation.
The force tolerance for geometric convergence. Requires units. Ex: 0.04 eV/Ang.
Allow lattice vectors to relax alongside atomic coordinates.
